answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 16051 Country: India Title: "Is it necessary to prostet ayat e sajda immidiately when we reach at time of reading quran or we can fisnish and do sajda afterward? Can we contniou reading quran and crsoosed two ayat e sajda then we have to do 2 sajda or one is enough for both? If we are not with wadoo and listn ayat e sajda then what to do? " Question: "Is it necessary to prostet ayat e sajda immidiately when we reach at time of reading quran or we can fisnish and do sajda afterward? Can we contniou reading quran and crsoosed two ayat e sajda then we have to do 2 sajda or one is enough for both? If we are not with wadoo and listn ayat e sajda then what to do? " Answer ID: 16051 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1486/1173/L=1430) It is better to perform sajdah instantly after reciting the verse, delaying is makrooh as one may forget it altogether. (2) In this case, he will have to perform two sajdah, one sajdah will not suffice. (3) It is better if you make wudhu and perform sajdah, otherwise it is mustahab to recite سمعنا واطعنا غفرانک ربنا والیک المصیر and perform sajdah later when feel easy: في التتارخانیۃ: یستحب للتالي أو السامع إذا لم یمکنہ السجود أن یقول: سمعنا وأطعنا غفرانک ربنا وإلیک المصیر (الشامي 2:583 ) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
